purpose.zh: 练握力，放松拉长背部两侧
purpose.en: Build grip strength and lengthen the sides of your back.

text.zh: 双手握杠，手臂伸直，身体自然挂着
text.en: Grip the bar with straight arms and let your body hang
Keep your body still without swinging.

text.zh: 快握不住前先踩稳再松手。
text.en: Step down safely before your grip gives out.

cautions.zh: 肩膀疼时缩短时间，或脚踩地分担体重
cautions.en: If your shoulders hurt, hang for less time or keep your feet on the floor to take some weight.

cautions.zh: 单杠不牢或下方没有落脚处时不要做
cautions.en: Do not hang if the bar is not secure or there is nowhere to step down.

changes: 动画全程静止悬挂 → kind hold（App 计时）；dose mode hold→time
名字去掉重复的「保持」；purpose 去掉「背阔肌」学名
cautions 改成适用悬垂的「X 时 Y」（原「缩小幅度」不适用）
